name: io.github.Automations-Project/airtable-user-mcp
title: Airtable User MCP
description: Manage Airtable bases via the internal API: schema inspection, table/field/view CRUD, formula validation and download, record CRUD, sidebar sections, record templates, extensions, base-to-base sync, and daemon control

tools.name: get_base_schema
tools.description: Get full schema of all tables, fields, and views in a base

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in a base with IDs and names

tools.name: get_table_schema
tools.description: Get full schema for a single table including fields and views

tools.name: list_fields
tools.description: List all fields in a table with id, name, and type (typeOptions via includeOptions)

tools.name: list_views
tools.description: List all views in a table with IDs, names, and types

tools.name: get_view
tools.description: Read a view's live configuration from the base.

tools.name: create_table
tools.description: Create a new table in an Airtable base.

tools.name: rename_table
tools.description: Rename a table in an Airtable base.

tools.name: delete_table
tools.description: Delete a table from an Airtable base.

tools.name: list_record_templates
tools.description: List all record templates for a table.

tools.name: create_record_template
tools.description: Create a new record template for a table.

tools.name: rename_record_template
tools.description: Rename an existing record template.

tools.name: update_record_template_description
tools.description: Set or update the description text of a record template.

tools.name: set_record_template_cell
tools.description: Pre-fill a field value on a record template.

tools.name: set_record_template_visible_columns
tools.description: Set which columns are shown (pre-fillable) on a record template.

tools.name: duplicate_record_template
tools.description: Duplicate a record template within the same or a different table.

tools.name: apply_record_template
tools.description: Apply (instantiate) a record template to create a new record pre-filled with the template's field values.

tools.name: delete_record_template
tools.description: ⚠️ DESTRUCTIVE — Permanently delete a record template.

tools.name: create_field
tools.description: Create a new field including computed types (formula, rollup, lookup, count)

tools.name: create_formula_field
tools.description: Create a formula field (shorthand)

tools.name: validate_formula
tools.description: Validate a formula expression before creating or updating

tools.name: download_formula_field
tools.description: Download the formula text of a formula field to a local file.

tools.name: download_base_formulas
tools.description: Download ALL formula fields from a base to local .formula files, organized into per-table subfolders.

tools.name: update_field_config
tools.description: Update configuration of any computed field

tools.name: update_formula_field
tools.description: Update the formula text of an existing formula field

tools.name: rename_field
tools.description: Rename a field with pre-validation

tools.name: delete_field
tools.description: Delete a field with safety guards and dependency checks

tools.name: delete_fields
tools.description: Delete multiple fields from an Airtable table in a single call.

tools.name: create_view
tools.description: Create a new view (grid, form, kanban, calendar, gallery, gantt, list)

tools.name: duplicate_view
tools.description: Clone a view with all configuration

tools.name: rename_view
tools.description: Rename a view

tools.name: delete_view
tools.description: Delete a view (cannot delete last view)

tools.name: update_view_description
tools.description: Set or clear a view's description

tools.name: update_view_filters
tools.description: Set filter conditions with AND/OR conjunctions

tools.name: reorder_view_fields
tools.description: Change column order in a view

tools.name: show_or_hide_view_columns
tools.description: Show or hide specific columns in a view

tools.name: apply_view_sorts
tools.description: Set or clear sort conditions on a view

tools.name: update_view_group_levels
tools.description: Set or clear grouping on a view

tools.name: update_view_row_height
tools.description: Change row height (small, medium, large, xlarge)

tools.name: list_view_sections
tools.description: List all sidebar sections for a table.

tools.name: create_view_section
tools.description: Create a new sidebar section in a table.

tools.name: rename_view_section
tools.description: Rename a sidebar section.

tools.name: delete_view_section
tools.description: Delete a sidebar section.

tools.name: move_view_to_section
tools.description: Move a view (or a section itself) within the sidebar.

tools.name: set_view_columns
tools.description: One-shot view-column reset: hides every column then shows only `visibleColumnIds` in the given left-to-right order, with optional freeze.

tools.name: show_or_hide_all_columns
tools.description: Show or hide every column in a view in one call.

tools.name: move_visible_columns
tools.description: Move columns by visible-only index (index 0 = leftmost shown column, hidden columns not counted).

tools.name: move_overall_columns
tools.description: Move one or more columns to a new position in the *overall* index (visible + hidden).

tools.name: update_frozen_column_count
tools.description: Set the frozen-column divider position for a grid view.

tools.name: set_view_cover
tools.description: Set the cover-image field and crop/fit mode for Kanban or Gallery views.

tools.name: set_view_color_config
tools.description: Apply a color config to a view (Kanban / Gallery / Calendar).

tools.name: set_view_cell_wrap
tools.description: Toggle whether long cell values wrap (multi-line) or truncate (single-line with ellipsis).

tools.name: set_calendar_date_columns
tools.description: Set the date-column ranges shown on a Calendar view.

tools.name: set_form_metadata
tools.description: Update one or more legacy-form-view metadata properties in a single call.

tools.name: set_form_submission_notification
tools.description: Toggle email-on-submit notifications for a specific user on a form view.

tools.name: update_field_description
tools.description: Set or update a field's description text

tools.name: duplicate_field
tools.description: Clone a field, optionally copying cell values

tools.name: create_extension
tools.description: Register a new extension/block in a base

tools.name: create_extension_dashboard
tools.description: Create a new dashboard page for extensions

tools.name: install_extension
tools.description: Install an extension onto a dashboard page

tools.name: update_extension_state
tools.description: Enable or disable an installed extension

tools.name: rename_extension
tools.description: Rename an installed extension

tools.name: duplicate_extension
tools.description: Clone an installed extension

tools.name: remove_extension
tools.description: Remove an extension from a dashboard

tools.name: query_records
tools.description: Read records from an Airtable table view.

tools.name: duplicate_records
tools.description: Duplicate one or more existing records within a table.

tools.name: create_records
tools.description: Create one or more records in a table.

tools.name: update_records
tools.description: Update primitive / single-select cells of existing records via cellValuesByColumnId.

tools.name: upload_attachment
tools.description: Upload attachments into an attachment cell by URL.

tools.name: delete_records
tools.description: Delete one or more records from a table in a single batch call.

tools.name: sync_base
tools.description: Base-to-base schema + record sync.

tools.name: manage_daemon
tools.description: Inspect and control the MCP daemon this server runs in.

tools.name: manage_tools
tools.description: Control which tools are available: list profiles, switch between read-only / safe-write / full / custom, and toggle individual tools or whole categories. Always enabled regardless of the active profile.
